text: Walt Disney World Resort is a destination operated by The Walt Disney Company, which the proxy statement identifies as the sole general partner of the registrant Walt Disney Entertainment Company (formerly The Walt Disney Company).

source.name: Walt Disney Co DEF 14A 2026 (SEC)
source.quote: References to the “Company,” “Disney,” “we,” “us” or “our” in this proxy statement refer collectively to The Walt Disney Company and the subsidiaries through which our various businesses are actually conducted.
